messages:
maya: Quick sync: product wants a preflight row that shows per-variant unit cost + estimated cache savings before we flip routing. We need low-ingest telemetry approach.

ravi: Agree. Hybrid sampling: 100% for billing/canary routes; adaptive reservoir (default 0.5%) for others. Each sampled event must include sample_rate so we can inverse-weight.

eli: Proposed event fields (no prompt text):
```json
{
  "ts":1755558012,
  "route_id":"r_app_chat",
  "tenant_id":"acct_900",
  "model_id":"rw-2.0",
  "variant":"int8-fast",
  "tokens_in":22,
  "tokens_out":180,
  "cache_hit":true,
  "cache_saved_tokens":110,
  "sample_rate":0.005,
  "route_policy":"sticky_v1",
  "is_canary":false
}
```
(maya: we already avoid shipping prompt text in telemetry).

ravi: Ingest plan: sampled events go to a fast aggregator that increments hour-keyed counters instead of persisting raw events. Store sum_w_x and sum_w_x2 where w=1/sample_rate so we can compute estimates and CI.

eli: Aggregator columns: hour, route, model, variant, cache_hit, sum_w_out, sum_w_saved, sum_w_out_sq, sum_w_saved_sq, sum_w, sample_count. From that we expose est_sum, ci_low, ci_high, effective_n.

maya: UI: compact row with sparkline + stacked bars for variants; toggle: "Estimated (sampled)" vs "Exact (100% routes)"; show small CI badge and tooltip: "95% CI from sampled telemetry". Hide band if sample_count < 30.

product-bot: note: product requests CSV export that includes sample_rate and effective_n for audit.

ravi: Edgecases: multi-layer caches -> include cache_layer when available or set cache_provenance="combined". Also include rollout_id and route_policy to attribute deltas.

eli: Validation: billing wants a daily reconciliation job comparing weighted estimates to full-capture ground truth for a sample set. If mismatch >1% alert billing. We'll run on staging first.

maya: Permissioning: add econ.variant_inspect scope. Default org-viewers see tenant-aggregates only. For private installs allow model/variant obfuscation via model_hash.

ingest-bot: deploy: telemetry-v3-preflight pushed to staging at 1755558100; aggregator prototype running on staging-shard-4.

maya: Action items: (1) eli to open RFC with schema + aggregator pseudocode; (2) ravi to wire aggregator counters + variance math; (3) maya to mock console row with CI microcopy; (4) billing to run ingest sims for 0.1/0.5/1% sample curves. I'll tag product & billing in the RFC.
